sources.snippet: Model overview Qwen3.5-2B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled-GGUF is a compact reasoning model built on the Qwen3.5-2B architecture and trained through knowledge distillation from Claude-4.6 Opus. sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
